{{Removed|date = 29th of October 2020}} {{For|other uses of [[XR (Disambiguation)|XR]]}} {{UnitInfobox |image-static = 600.png |image-dynamic = XR600Dynamic.png |pseudoxd = true |source = [[Mecha Base]] |type = Vehicle (& Humanoid) |spawnrate = [[File:VehicleSpawn.png|20px|Spawnrate]]60s (Level 0)
[[File:VehicleSpawn.png|20px|Spawnrate]]45s (Level 1) |health = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]250 |damage_type = Single
Collision |ranged_damage = [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]]8 |ranged_firerate = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]0.45 |ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]32 |speed = 4 |hidden = No }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''XR600''' was the first vehicle that spawned from the [[Mecha Base]]. It spawned when the [[Mecha Base]] was at Level 0 or Level 1. As with other units, it started from the end of the map path and moved towards the entrance of the map. The '''XR600''' had a spawnrate of 60 seconds at Level 0. At Level 1, spawnrate was changed to 45 seconds. '''XR600''' could attack enemies with its turret. ==Appearance== '''XR600''' was a blue tracked mech. The operator could shoot from its turret. The operator itself had yellow skin, its torso and legs were black, and it wore white goggles. ==Strategy== *'''XR600''' can be useful against hordes of high health enemies like the [[Giant Boss]], [[Chained Boss]] or [[Slow Boss]]. **Due to its long range, it can easily attack enemies from a long distance. *On two-pathed maps, only one '''XR600''' will spawn per Level 0-1 [[Mecha Base]]. It will go down a random path in some maps, like [[Infernal Abyss]], but may always go down one specific path in other maps, like [[Badlands]]. *The '''XR600''' can deal full collision damage to shielded enemies, like the [[Summoner Boss]] and [[Templar]]. **Even more interestingly, damage from its turrets is not capped, meaning that the '''XR600''' can operate at maximum DPS against these enemies. **However, due to its low health and DPS for the time these appear, it is not recommended to use the '''XR600''' against these enemies. *As with other units, the firerate and range of '''XR600''' cannot be boosted by the [[Commander]] or [[DJ Booth]], respectively. *'''XR600''' cannot be stunned by any enemy, making it very useful against such enemies. **However, such enemies generally only appear on later waves, where the '''XR600''' will not perform well due to its low health and DPS. *While '''XR600''' can collide with [[Hidden]]s and [[Ninja]]s, it cannot detect them. **Do note that because of its low health, the '''XR600''' can be easily destroyed if it collides with multiple of them. ==Trivia== *The goggles worn by the operator inside '''XR600''' are a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|833772989|Laser Spec Special Forces Goggles}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. ==Update History== *'''7 January 2020''' - [[Release v1.5|Release v1.5.1a]] **'''XR600''' added. *'''26 January 2020''' - [[Release v1.6|Release v1.6.0]] **Appearance changed, previous appearance is now used by the [[Armored XR600]]. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **'''XR600''' removed, replaced by [[Mark I]]. {{TowerNavBox}} [[Category:Exclusive Content]]
